title: Trend across several horizons
author: arhancanli
rationale: Combines trend signals of about one, three, six and twelve months and scales the position to its volatility. Averaging horizons means it does not rest on one chosen window.
risks: Trend rules lose in markets that reverse often, and can lose for years at a time. Going short can suffer in sharp rebounds, and the chosen horizons are themselves a choice that was made.
references: Hurst, Ooi and Pedersen (2017), A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing, Journal of Portfolio Management
